Hi Elena / Raj — Vivek from Redwood security here. Thanks for the clear questions; answering inline below.

1) VendorY cache access and encryption:
- VendorY stores model inference cache in an isolated tenant per customer. By default, cached content is encrypted at rest using provider-managed keys; for customers on Private deployments or those requesting customer-keying, we support customer-managed KMS (BYOK) so data is encrypted with customer-specific keys and vendors do not have access to plaintext.
- VendorY does not receive decrypted user content from Redwood unless explicitly configured by the customer for concierge integrations. We treat cache storage as a non-persistent optimization layer and rotate ephemeral keys as part of our pipeline.

2) External KMS providers (hosted mode):
- AWS KMS (us-west-2, us-east-1)
- GCP Cloud KMS (us-central1)
- Azure Key Vault (eastus)
We list these in the attached subprocessors CSV with locations and applicable use cases.

3) Attestations for critical subprocessors:
- We require SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 for subprocessors that handle customer data or critical infrastructure. For edge cases where a subprocess does not have a formal attestation, we maintain compensating controls (strict access controls, contractual SCAs, monthly configuration scans, and penetration test evidence). These compensating controls are documented in our vendor risk runbook (link below).

4) SBOM and vulnerability management:
- We produce SBOMs for the inference runtime and maintain an internal SBOM registry. Public SBOMs are available to customers under NDA.
- Our CVE handling policy: triage within 48 hours, patch plan within 7 days for critical vulnerabilities, weekly tracking in Jira (JIRA:SEC-4321).

Supporting links / attachments:
- SOC 2: SOC2-TypeII-Report-Redwood-2025-redacted.pdf (attached)
- Subprocessors CSV: Redwood_Subprocessors_2026-02.csv (attached)
- SIG: SIG-Assessment-Redwood-2026.xlsx (attached)
- Internal vendor inventory: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-Redwood-Vendor-Inventory
- Jira vuln tracker: JIRA:SEC-4321

If Acme needs the unredacted SOC 2 report or deeper auditor evidence, we can arrange an auditor NDA and a secure read-only share. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if you want to walk through the controls.
